description_en: Runs interactive commands in a cluster node
description_zh: 调用InvokeShellCommand在指定的集群节点内执行交互命令
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc invoke-shell-command --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command echo_hello_world --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeShellCommand

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The content of the command. The content must be 2 to 2,048 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命令内容。长度为2~2048个字符
parameters.name: command

parameters.help_en: The working directory of the command. Default value: `/root`
parameters.help_zh: 命令工作目录。默认值为`/root`
parameters.name: working_dir

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period. If a command times out, the command process will be terminated. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
超时时间，超时将终止命令进程。单位：秒

默认值：60
parameters.name: timeout

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Nth node instance on which the command is run.

This parameter specifies the node on which the command is run. If it is not specified, the command will be run on all nodes of the cluster
fields.help_zh:
第N个执行命令的节点实例ID。
用于限定执行范围，不指定则默认在集群所有节点上执行
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information of nodes on which the command is run
parameters.help_zh: 执行命令的节点信息列表
parameters.name: instance

CommandId.description_en: The ID of the command. It is used to query the execution status of the command
CommandId.description_zh: 命令ID，可用于后续查询命令执行情况
